summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Education to encourage colleges and universities to create and carry out comprehensive mental health and suicide prevention plans, coordinating with the Department of Health and Human Services and aligning with existing federal programs and recommended approaches, without creating new requirements for institutions.

scores.thoughts: The bill encourages institutions of higher education to develop mental health and suicide prevention plans and requires the Secretary to report on these efforts. While it doesn't directly appropriate new funds, the coordination and reporting efforts imply some level of administrative cost, which is a minor increase in government activity and potential spending.

The bill directly amends the Higher Education Act of 1965 to promote mental health and suicide prevention plans on college campuses. This is a central focus of the bill, aiming to improve the educational environment and support services for students.
